title: Privacy Policy
metaDescription: How Peak Roofing Co collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

data.body:
This is a starter template and not legal advice. Review and customize it with qualified counsel before publishing. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website.

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, phone number, email, and project details when you request a quote or contact us — and basic technical data (like IP address and browser type) collected automatically.

How We Use Your Information

  • Respond to inquiries and provide estimates
  • Schedule and deliver services
  • Send updates you have requested
  • Improve our website and services

Cookies & Analytics

We use cookies and privacy-friendly analytics to understand site usage. See our Cookie Policy for details and choices.

Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with service providers who help us operate (e.g. CRM, scheduling) and as required by law.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information. Contact us using the details below.

Data Retention & Security

We retain information only as long as needed for the purposes described and use reasonable safeguards to protect it.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

Contact

Questions? Email info@peakroofingco.com or call (208) 555-0147.
